summary: GMI Cloud's MiniMax Week (Aug 24 – Sep 6, 2026) makes the MiniMax lineup free for fourteen days: M3 (frontier reasoning), M2.7 (fast agent/coding reasoning), Speech 2.8 (TTS and voice cloning), and Music 3.0 (full generated tracks). Access via a GMI API key or OpenRouter's :free variants, with native integrations in Pi, Oh My Pi, Hermes Agent, Trae, and OpenCode, and BYOK support for Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor. Account creation is free; H3 generative video is not included and stays at standard pricing. A concurrent MiniMaxathon challenge awards $200 in GMI credits plus a 3-month MiniMax token plan per track winner.
claim_steps: Create a free GMI Cloud account at https://console.gmicloud.ai.
Use MiniMax models via the GMI Model Hub API key, or through OpenRouter using the :free variants (e.g. openrouter.ai/minimax/minimax-m3:free).
Optionally integrate natively in Pi, Oh My Pi, Hermes Agent, Trae, or OpenCode — or BYOK into Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor.
Use the models free until September 6, 2026; standard pricing applies afterward.

social_proof.caption: Curator's firsthand run: MiniMax M3 served through GMI Cloud driving an agent session at ~170 tok/s (status bar: gmi/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3 · $0.05 spent, cache hits). "Very fast."
